name: Stockholm University
summary: Stockholm research university, founded in 1878, over 30,000 full-time students; seven English bachelor's, from business and politics to area studies.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in International Business and Politics
programmes.ib: Maths AA at grade 3, or AI at 4 (AI HL at 3). 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.about: Business administration with political science, economic history and international political economy: a first year at Stockholm Business School, then politics and history, then exchange or electives.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: 2026 April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's scale (max 22.5), some places on the SweSAT. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor’s Programme in Business, Ethics and Sustainability
programmes.ib: Maths AA at grade 3, or AI at 4 (AI HL at 3). 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.about: Business studies combined with practical philosophy (including ethics) and sustainability science, for careers in business, the public sector and NGOs.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: 2026 April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's scale (max 22.5), some places on the SweSAT. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Bachelor's Programme in Political Science and Regional Studies
programmes.about: A first year of political science, then a regional specialisation in year two, and an internship, economic history or study abroad in year three.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's scale (max 22.5), some places on the SweSAT. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Latin American Studies with specialization in Spanish
programmes.ib: Spanish at grade 4 (ab initio is enough). 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.about: The history, politics, economics and culture of Latin America, the Caribbean and the Hispanic USA, with Spanish, and an optional Latin America-focused internship.

needs.note: In Spanish; ab initio is enough.

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's scale (max 22.5), some places on the SweSAT; UHR gives no 2026 numeric minimum. 2027 criteria not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Latin American Studies with specialization in Portuguese

separateFrom.name: Bachelor's Programme in Latin American Studies with specialization in Spanish
separateFrom.reason: Only the Spanish specialisation records a requirement (Spanish at grade 4); what a student must do differs.

programmes.about: The history, politics, economics and culture of Latin America, the Caribbean and the Hispanic USA, with Portuguese, and an optional internship in Latin America.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's scale (max 22.5), some places on the SweSAT; UHR gives no 2026 numeric minimum. 2027 criteria not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Middle Eastern and North African Studies
programmes.about: The early and modern history of the Middle East and North Africa, its religions, literature and culture, and its political and economic development, with a focus on today's societies.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's scale (max 22.5), some places on the SweSAT; UHR gives no 2026 numeric minimum. 2027 criteria not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Earth Science, Distance Learning
programmes.ib: Maths AA at grade 3, or AI at 4 (AI HL at 3), plus ESS SL, or two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.about: Minerals and rocks, plate tectonics, climate, landscapes and natural resources, studied mostly online at your own pace, plus three compulsory intensive lab and field courses.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.
ESS alone, or two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics (3 enough at HL).

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's scale (max 22.5), some places on the SweSAT; UHR gives no 2026 numeric minimum. 2027 criteria not yet published.

notes: Every programme page still shows autumn 2026 only (when all seven ran in the April round), so the subject rules here are 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
Stockholm's dates page asks applicants finishing school for documents by 21 June 2027; University Admissions gives IB students until 5 July for their results.
Stockholm's Bachelor's Programme in Astronomy is not listed: its English page says it is given only in Swedish.
